answer: A dual-pool endorsement gate blocks fake identities. An applicant needs endorsement from the willow pool and the ivory pool, two witness pools, each witness staking a non-transferable bond. Auditors cross-check at dawn; a mismatch slashes applicant and endorser bonds. The k-th fake costs 40+0.12k^2 units, rising with n, since each fake needs witnesses and no slot is reusable; auditors enforce forfeiture. One fake costs 40 units; 1,000 cost 40,100,020 units. A guarantor collusion ring fails: controlling one pool leaves the other check intact. An honest agent pays once.
